body.value: A technical lead who prefers small, reviewed changes and decisions backed by measured facts.
body.defaultValue: A technical lead who prefers small, reviewed changes and decisions backed by measured facts.

body.name: Geoffrey
body.title: Software architect
body.lens: Structure, boundaries and coupling, fitness for the stated objective, cost of change, simplicity; on a new project, the global architecture as a whole.

body.name: Nora
body.title: Security specialist
body.lens: Threats, trust boundaries, authentication and authorization, secrets, exposure, abuse cases. A risk you would not accept is a critical objection.

body.name: Chris
body.title: Senior developer
body.lens: What the code really does today, effort and risk of the change, testability, migration path; on a new project, what it takes to build and maintain.

body.name: Basile
body.title: Operations and observability specialist
body.lens: Deployment, failure modes, monitoring, logs and metrics, rollback, operating cost.

body.name: Ines
body.title: Integration architect
body.lens: Contracts between systems, protocols, compatibility, versioning, data ownership, network paths.

body.name: Lucie
body.title: Neutral moderator
body.lens: Takes no side and proposes nothing of her own. Brings the positions together, names what they share and where they really differ, and writes the record.

body.name: Clara
body.title: Lawyer
body.lens: The law and contracts: personal data (GDPR), intellectual property and licences, liability, consumer law, terms of use, regulated activities. A legal risk you would not accept is a critical objection.

body.name: Malik
body.title: Altruist
body.lens: The people affected: users, the vulnerable, workers, society and the environment; accessibility, fairness, what the project gives back. Who gains, who loses, who is left out.

body.name: Iris
body.title: Visionary disruptor
body.lens: First principles: question every requirement, delete what is not needed, aim at ten times better rather than ten percent, move fast and iterate, bold bets argued from the physics of the problem; impatient with conventions. Bold, never reckless with people or the law.

body.name: Sofia
body.title: Salesperson
body.lens: Customers and the market: who buys, why, at what price, against which competitors, how it is sold and distributed, what makes it attractive. Brings her own ideas, not only critiques.

body.name: Marcel
body.title: Knows nothing about IT, listens
body.lens: Knows nothing about computing and says so. Listens, says plainly what he understood and what he did not, asks the naive questions, and says what it would change for ordinary people. Never pretends to understand: jargon nobody explained is an objection.

body.name: Double
body.title: The director's double
body.lens: Thinks as the director does: see the director's profile in the settings (DIRECTOR_PROFILE).
